methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-15: Bloomerang (bloomerang.com/pricing), Little Green Light (littlegreenlight.com/pricing), Keela (keela.co/pricing), Givebutter (givebutter.com/pricing), DonorSnap (donorsnap.com/pricing), DonorPerfect (donorperfect.com/pricing and /fundraising-software/pricing-guide). Neon CRM's official page (neonone.com) returned HTTP 403; plan names and prices ($99/$209/$409) corroborated via Capterra and multiple 2026 review aggregators. Corrections made: DonorSnap plan names were fabricated and have been replaced with the actual contact-capacity tier labels (prices were correct). Keela's SOC2 claim was removed (not stated on any official Keela page; only sourced from a third-party blog). DonorPerfect Plus/Pro remain null (quote-only; only the $99 Core starting price is published). Network for Good (redirects to bonterratech.com, quote-only) and Kindful (acquired into Bloomerang) excluded. All accessedAt=2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Bloomerang
vendors.provenance: Fetched bloomerang.com/pricing directly on 2026-06-15; starting prices confirmed: CRM $125/mo, Fundraising add-on $40/mo, Volunteer $119/mo (all billed annually), The Giving Platform bundle quote-only. SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI DSS explicitly confirmed on bloomerang.com/security-policy.

plans.name: Bloomerang CRM
plans.notes: Starts at $125/month billed annually for up to ~1,000 constituent records. Includes unlimited users, donor retention analytics, online giving forms, email marketing, reporting. Price scales with record count; larger tiers require sales quote.

plans.name: Bloomerang Fundraising
plans.notes: Add-on starting at $40/month billed annually; must be bundled with Bloomerang CRM. Includes donation forms, event management, text fundraising, auctions, peer-to-peer fundraising.

plans.name: Bloomerang Volunteer
plans.notes: Volunteer management add-on starting at $119/month billed annually. Includes AI-powered scheduling, communication tools, screening/verification, CRM data sync.

plans.name: The Giving Platform
plans.notes: All-in-one bundle: CRM + Fundraising + Volunteer. Price not published; requires contacting sales.

limits: Constituent-based pricing — cost increases with record count
Entry tier ~1,000 records at $125/mo annual
Fundraising module requires CRM bundle
keyFeatures: Donor retention analytics and likelihood-to-give scores
Unlimited users on all plans
Integrated CRM + fundraising + volunteer management suite
Constituent-based predictive insights
bestFor: Teams wanting an all-in-one giving platform
enrichment.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from bloomerang.com/pricing on 2026-06-15. Security data from bloomerang.com/security-policy confirming SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI DSS.
